function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies the customer using a 4-digit PIN or birth year before debt details can be disclosed.

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PIN or year provided by the customer.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs a Promise to Pay (PTP) when the customer agrees to a payment date and amount.

ptp_date.description: The agreed payment date in ISO-8601 format (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD).

amount.description: The amount the customer promised to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Sends a payment link to the customer.

channel.description: The channel to send the link through.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Escalates the call to a human agent for hardship claims or disputes.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final disposition and outcome of the call.

notes.description: Any additional notes regarding the disposition.
